pin.title: PIN
pin.notSignedIn: Sign in first (Settings → Account). Your PIN is kept by the server, so it needs an account.
pin.setIntro: A PIN keeps your Only me records yours: a device becomes you only after your PIN is entered on it. Use 4 to 6 digits.
pin.changeIntro: Your other devices will ask for the new PIN once.
pin.saved: PIN saved. Your other devices will ask for it once.
pin.offline: You're offline. The PIN needs a connection.
pin.enterIntro: {{name}} has a PIN. Enter it to use this device as {{name}}.
pin.lockedNow: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in 15 minutes.
pin.locked: Too many wrong PINs. Try again after {{time}}.
pin.errorFormat: The PIN must be 4 to 6 digits.
pin.errorNotSynced: This person hasn't synced yet. Try again in a moment.
pin.errorNotVerified: Enter your PIN on this device first.
pin.errorRemoved: This person was removed from the household.
pin.errorSignIn: Sign in again on this device.
pin.otherDeviceHint: Forgot it? Change it on any other device where you're already {{name}} (Settings → Household → Change your PIN), then enter the new one here.
pin.setForgetHint: If you forget it, change it on any other device of yours (Settings → Household), or ask someone in the household to reset it from theirs.
pin.forgotOtherDevice: On any other device where you're already {{name}}, open Settings → Household → Change your PIN. Then enter the new PIN here. Nothing is lost.
pin.forgotAskMember: No other device? Someone else in the household can set a new PIN for {{name}} from their own device: Settings → Household → Reset PIN, under {{name}}. {{name}} will see who did it.
pin.forgotEmailIntro: Or get a code sent to the account's email.
pin.emailSent: We sent a 6-digit code to the account's email. Enter it with your new PIN. It expires in 15 minutes.
pin.resetForIntro: Set a new PIN for {{name}}, then tell them what it is. Their devices will ask for it and show that you reset it from this device. This device stays yours: it doesn't get {{name}}'s Only me records.
pin.resetForDone: Done. Tell {{name}} the new PIN — they can change it afterwards.
pin.resetNoticeBy: Your PIN was reset by {{name}} on {{device}} ({{when}}).
pin.resetNoticeEmail: Your PIN was reset with a code from the account email, on {{device}} ({{when}}).
